text: Can you describe the location and nature of your abdominal pain, and did it start suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent heart attack, I am concerned about a potential loss of blood flow to your intestines. Can you describe the character of the pain, such as whether it feels out of proportion to the physical exam, and do you have any history of atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain. I also have Bloody loose bowel movements, No vomiting, Sudden onset.
